clue.text: Job of serving girl with super hair in part of mansion?

indicators.note: the super hair is placed in the middle of the part of the mansion

parts.note: a wing is a section of a large house
A1 means first-rate, written here as A and the digit one read as I
a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: A lady's maid with splendid hair is working in one wing of a grand house.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 (super) is written AI, with the figure one standing in as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: The work a waitress does is serving food at tables, so the occupation itself fits the description.

clue.text: Some distortion in bit of newspaper covering conflicts

parts.note: conflicts in general are war
a page is one leaf of a newspaper

explanation.surface: A newspaper's report on wars is accused of slanting the facts.
explanation.walkthrough: A page covering conflicts reads as a WAR PAGE, so 'covering' simply links the two halves.
explanation.definitionFit: Warpage is the bending or twisting of something out of shape, a kind of distortion.

clue.text: One slowing down is an irritation in the pupil's environment

definitions.text: an irritation in the pupil's environment

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
rit. is the musical abbreviation for ritardando, slowing down

explanation.surface: A slow learner is described as a nuisance in the classroom.
explanation.walkthrough: The pupil is the dark centre of the eye, not a schoolchild; its environment is the iris.
explanation.definitionFit: Iritis is inflammation of the iris, the coloured ring surrounding the eye's pupil.

clue.text: Purpose in respect of what a crossword demands

parts.note: re means concerning or with regard to
a crossword asks to be solved, so it demands a solution

explanation.surface: A solver states their aim with regard to the puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: Resolution is firmness of purpose, a determined intention.

clue.text: Window frame made of special wood

parts.note: ash is a tree and its timber

explanation.surface: A window frame is built from a particular timber.
explanation.definitionFit: A sash is the sliding frame holding the glass panes of a window.

clue.text: Sacrifice made by one friend crossing Flanders, cut down

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: the friend stretches across the cut-down Flanders, holding it inside

parts.note: a mate is a pal

indicators.note: cut down means shortened by its final letter

parts.note: Moll Flanders is the heroine of Defoe's novel

explanation.surface: A soldier's friend dies crossing the Flanders battlefields of the First World War.
explanation.walkthrough: Flanders is Defoe's Moll Flanders, not the battlefield; 'cut down' trims MOLL to MOL.
explanation.definitionFit: To immolate is to kill as an offering, especially by burning, so it means to sacrifice.

clue.text: Travel to party in Holland on a boat

parts.note: to go is to travel

indicators.note: the party sits inside the abbreviation for Holland

parts.note: NL is the international code for the Netherlands
a do is a party

explanation.surface: Someone travels to a party in the Netherlands aboard a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A gondola is a long flat-bottomed Venetian rowing vessel.

clue.text: Port offered in pubs in Spanish-speaking areas

indicators.note: the port is placed inside the pubs

parts.note: bars are pubs
Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port, often shortened to Rio

explanation.surface: Port wine is served in the bars of Spanish-speaking districts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Port' looks like the drink; it is the city Rio.
explanation.definitionFit: Barrios are districts or neighbourhoods in Spanish-speaking towns and cities.

clue.text: Register opposition when rubbish is collected in Oregon

indicators.note: rubbish is gathered up inside the phrase for registering opposition

parts.note: to register opposition is to be averse
tat is shoddy rubbish

explanation.surface: Residents object to how refuse collection works in an American state.
explanation.definitionFit: The Beaver State is the official nickname of Oregon, after the animal prized by fur trappers there.

clue.text: Original artist in deal that falls short

indicators.note: the artist goes inside the shortened deal
falls short means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a sale is a deal or transaction
Tracey Emin is a British artist

explanation.surface: An innovative painter is involved in a business deal that fails to complete.
explanation.definitionFit: Seminal work is highly original and influential, sowing the seeds of later developments.

clue.text: Bookish type to esteem high-class among the junk

indicators.note: the esteem and the high-class letter are placed among the junk

parts.note: litter is rubbish, junk
to rate is to esteem
U means upper-class, socially acceptable

explanation.surface: A literary type values quality amid a pile of rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: U is the old British label for upper-class usage, as opposed to non-U.
explanation.definitionFit: A littérateur is a literary person, a writer or lover of books.

clue.text: A blemish on the west side of bad old American city

indicators.note: in an across entry the west side is the left, so the blemish comes before what follows

parts.note: to mar is to blemish
ill means bad

explanation.surface: A flaw is found on the western side of a run-down old American town.
explanation.definitionFit: Amarillo is a city in the Texas Panhandle in the United States.

clue.text: University involved in issue very energetically

indicators.note: the university letter is wrapped inside the word for issue

parts.note: to allot is to issue or distribute

explanation.surface: A university is drawn into a contentious matter with great vigour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'issue' looks like a noun, a matter; it is the verb meaning to hand out.
explanation.definitionFit: Going at something with maximum effort is to go at it with every ounce of energy.

clue.text: Possibly it is badly restricting one

definitions.text: Possibly it is badly restricting one

indicators.note: the scrambled letters close around the one, hemming it in
possibly signals that the following words may be rearranged

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A condition, being bad, may hold a person back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' looks like the anagram signal but is fodder; 'Possibly' does the shuffling.
explanation.definitionFit: A handicap or impairment may well be something that limits a person.

clue.text: What could be money for employees entertaining has-beens

definitions.text: What could be money for employees
definitions.meaning: expenses paid to staff, informally shortened
former partners, people who once were but are no longer

explanation.surface: A firm's expenses budget is used to treat former staff.
explanation.definitionFit: Exes is slang both for expenses and for former spouses or partners, past ones.

clue.text: Fanciful tapestries that may be seen in certain clubs

definitions.text: that may be seen in certain clubs

indicators.note: fanciful suggests an imaginative rearrangement of the word that follows

explanation.surface: Ornate wall hangings might be displayed in some gentlemen's clubs.
explanation.definitionFit: Some nightclubs put on erotic undressing acts as their entertainment.

clue.text: Child entertained by a queen and daughter may be a mite

indicators.note: the child is held inside the queen, as a guest is entertained

parts.note: a rani is a Hindu queen

explanation.surface: A royal and her daughter host a tiny youngster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mite' suggests a small child; here it is the tiny eight-legged creature.
explanation.definitionFit: Mites belong to the class of eight-legged creatures that also includes spiders and scorpions.

clue.text: Like a priest's attire, making a lot scared unfortunately

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things gone wrong, so the letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A cleric's vestments frighten many people.
explanation.definitionFit: Sacerdotal means relating to priests or the priesthood, so it describes clerical dress.

clue.text: Woman in yacht at sea

indicators.note: at sea means confused, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A woman is aboard a yacht out on the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: Cynthia is a female first name, so it indicates a woman.

clue.text: A poet among tombs with no yen for place with big mausoleum

indicators.note: with no means the following letter is removed

parts.note: Thomas Gray wrote the Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard, set among graves
Y is the abbreviation for the Japanese yen

explanation.surface: A poet wanders a graveyard, lacking desire, near a famous tomb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'yen' looks like longing; it is the currency, Y.
explanation.definitionFit: Agra in India is home to the Taj Mahal, a vast marble tomb built by Shah Jahan.

clue.text: From what we hear, yesteryear's England footballer is sorrowful

indicators.note: from what we hear signals a word sounding like another

parts.note: Jimmy Greaves was a prolific England striker of the 1960s

explanation.surface: A former England player is said to be unhappy.
explanation.definitionFit: To grieve is to feel deep sorrow, especially over a loss.

clue.text: Because I give up

parts.note: for can mean because, as in 'for he was tired'
the ego is the self, the I

explanation.surface: Someone explains their surrender in two words.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a variant spelling of forgo, meaning to do without or relinquish.

clue.text: Bill at home starts to race and falls over — this may help the bruises

indicators.note: falling over turns the whole group of pieces upside down, read backwards

parts.note: AC is short for account, a bill
in means at home

indicators.note: starts to picks the opening letter of each of the next two words

explanation.surface: Bill, racing around at home, trips over and needs something for his bruises.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bill' looks like a man's name; it is an account, AC.
explanation.definitionFit: Arnica is a herbal remedy made from a mountain plant, traditionally applied to bruises.

clue.text: Poison — the thing engulfing company in square

indicators.note: the inner group is placed inside the square number

parts.note: nine is a square number, three times three

indicators.note: the thing swallows the company abbreviation

parts.note: it means the thing

explanation.surface: A toxin overwhelms a business in a town square.
explanation.definitionFit: Nicotine, the addictive alkaloid in tobacco, is toxic in larger doses and used as an insecticide.

clue.text: Old Labour no good for the city

indicators.note: no means the following letter is dropped

parts.note: a slog is hard labour

explanation.surface: The traditional Labour party is no good for the city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old Labour' suggests the British political label; it is split into old and labour.
explanation.definitionFit: Oslo is the capital city of Norway.

clue.text: Small child in America at edge of lake — an urchin needing water

indicators.note: edge of takes the letter at the far end of the next word

parts.note: CH is the shortened form of child
US is the United States

explanation.surface: A little American kid on a lakeshore is a scruffy street child in need of a wash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'urchin' suggests a ragged child; with 'needing water' it is the sea urchin.
explanation.definitionFit: Echinus is the genus name for sea urchins, spiny creatures that live in the sea.

clue.text: I must get shelter around start of evening — it's become frosty

indicators.note: the shelter goes around the opening letter

parts.note: cover is shelter

indicators.note: start of picks the opening letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Someone needs to get indoors as evening falls and the temperature drops.
explanation.definitionFit: When a surface ices over it freezes up, covered with a frosty coating.

clue.text: Grandson you get fussed about, showing male and female characteristics

indicators.note: getting fussed about suggests being agitated, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A doting grandparent frets over a grandchild's gender expression.
explanation.definitionFit: Androgynous describes someone with both masculine and feminine traits.
